overview.description: The ProShares Ultra SK hynix ETF (SKHU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x exposure to the daily returns of SK hynix Inc. (NASDAQ: SKHY) stock, less expenses. SKHU was launched on Jul 13, 2026 and is issued by ProShares.
